recent: BIOHLDG 在 2026 年 11 月发布了 2025 年年报，并出现董事局变动，包括 MR KOO KIEN YOON 和 DATUK DR HON TIAN KOK@WILLIAM 的职位变更。公司还发布了截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的季度报告，新闻指出第三季度税前盈利为 51 万令吉，但首九个月仍亏损 441 万令吉。

news.title: Bioalpha Swings to 3QFY2026 Profit Before Tax of RM0.51 Million, But 9M Loss Remains at RM4.41 Million

recent_en: BIOHLDG released its 2025 annual report in November 2026 and saw boardroom changes, including position changes for MR KOO KIEN YOON and DATUK DR HON TIAN KOK@WILLIAM. The company also released its quarterly report for the period ended 30 September 2026, with news noting a 3Q pre-tax profit of RM0.51 million but a nine-month loss of RM4.41 million.
notable_en: Released 2025 Annual Report and CG Report.
